role: stages of the single-point derivative over a parameter system
notes: Morley 1965 p.521 n.13 variant of S^alpha and Tr^alpha: the fibre condition asks for at most one point instead of isolated points. Distinct from Morley's S^alpha(A) and Tr^alpha(A).

role: single-point rank of a type
notes: Ordinal beta with p in Tr_natural^beta(A); undefined when p lies in every stage. Not Morley rank, not degree, not RM of a definable set.

role: stages of the exactly-one-point reading of the derivative
notes: Proof-local comparison recursion; shows the literal reading leaves a type of ACF_0 unranked.

role: Jonsson's subsystem relation between systems of a class
notes: Jonsson 1956 p.194 notation; for N(T) it is Morley's A subset B as subsystems. Not elementary substructure.

role: power of a system in Jonsson's notation
notes: Jonsson 1956 p.194; equals Morley's kappa(A). Not Morley's Sigma^* normalization. Original form descriptor: prefix; no numerical precedence rank is asserted.

role: extension of a system by a set of elements
notes: Jonsson 1962 Definition 4.1 p.184; in N(T) the subsystem on |A| union U.

role: sentence saying a formula has at least n+1 solutions
notes: Proof-local counting sentence.

role: substitution of a tuple into the first n variables
notes: Proof-local; result is a one-variable formula over A together with the tuple.

role: the sequence-coding theory and its normalization
notes: Theory of (omega^omega, f_n) with f_n(x)(m)=x(<n,m>).

role: graph relation of the coding function f_n
notes: Local to the coding example; distinct from Vaught's formula set F_n(T) and Morley's F(A).

role: object class and class of map triples of a concrete category
notes: Morley 1965 p.518 notation: a category is a class of triples (f:A->B) closed under identities and composition.

role: class of type spaces and class of restriction-map triples
notes: Morley 1965 p.519 notation; C(T) consists of (f^*:S(B)->S(A)) for monomorphisms f:A->B in N(T).

role: diagram of a system: open sentences of L(A) true in A
notes: Morley 1965 pp.516-517 notation; T(A)=T union D(A).

role: identity map of A into B for A a subsystem of B
notes: Morley 1965 p.519 n.11; i_{AB}^* is its restriction map (already used in def:p03-morley-type-space).

role: replacement of each constant a-bar by f(a)-bar in a formula of L(A)
notes: Morley 1965 p.519 notation for the induced map F(A)->F(B); here applied to all sentences of L(A). Original form descriptor: prefix; no numerical precedence rank is asserted.

role: replacement of each new constant c by the constant of its interpretation
notes: Local to clause 2 of the syntactic dictionary; not a Skolem or permutation symbol. Original form descriptor: prefix; no numerical precedence rank is asserted.

role: type with c substituted for v_0; T(A) together with p(c)
notes: T_p is proof-local in the annex; p(c) appears in clause 4.

role: model of T(B) reread as an L(A)-structure through f
notes: Proof-local.

role: open formulas of F(A)
notes: Proof-local subalgebra; isomorphic to F(A) by Morley p.518 n.9.

role: Morley's notation for satisfaction of a sentence in a system
notes: Morley 1965 p.516; mentioned once and rendered as \(A\entails\psi\) in this section to avoid the registry's derivability turnstile.
